name: tia_get_block_attributes
description: Read the verified PLC block attributes IsConsistent and IsKnowHowProtected for one exact block. For an OB also SecondaryType, CyclicTime and PhaseOffset (microseconds, with Unit 'us' and ValueMs), PriorityNumber and the read-only CyclicApplicationCycleTime; an attribute the OB does not have is reported with Status 'not_supported'.

plc_name.description: Exact PLC software name; required when the project has multiple PLCs.

group_path.description: Exact block-group path, required when the block name is duplicated. Use an empty string for the root group.
